hypothesis: Transposition-aware exploration (STS_SILVER_SHARED_CHILD_EXPLORATION=1) does not reduce and may improve whole-run outcomes at an equal flat 10,000-simulation budget.

cohort.execution: 16 jobs (2 arms x 8 shards of 4 seeds), interleaved control/shared, xargs -P4 on 4 cores; no tree profile or scan

command: env -i HOME PATH OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 STS_EXECUTABLE_GIT_SHA=a1e9a1a... STS_SILVER_ADAPTIVE=0 [STS_SILVER_SHARED_CHILD_EXPLORATION=1] bash tools/seed_guard.sh build/linux-gcc-release/one_combat bestbench 10000 4 0 <offset> <arm>_<offset>.csv
analysis: merge shards per arm; python3 paired_analysis.py control.csv shared.csv (paired by seed, fixed-seed bootstrap)

decision_rule.primary: paired win-rate difference shared - control with the analyzer's 95% bootstrap interval
decision_rule.reject: interval upper bound below 0, or paired mean floor difference interval entirely below 0
decision_rule.advance: point estimate >= 0 with no interval entirely below 0 -> a larger frozen cohort (e.g. 128 paired seeds) before any default change
decision_rule.inconclusive: otherwise; no default change either way
decision_rule.note: 32 seeds is a screen; it cannot qualify a default. Run time per seed is reported but trajectories differ between arms.
